About Sketch BIM
Sketch BIM is a conceptual architectural CAD/BIM environment with drafting, component tools, quantity-oriented object information and 3D visualization. Its structural, MEP and code-oriented features are preliminary design aids, not independently certified engineering tools.
Professional evaluation edition · Local browser application · Save projects regularly

Adjust the drafting canvas and presentation palette. These settings never change object geometry or project quantities.

INTELLIGENT OBJECTS · VERTASCAN

Parametric furniture, fixtures, stairs and technical assemblies. Dimensions in metres; examples are conceptual, not code-certified.

Wall / Line Alignment

Auto snap uses the nearest visible, unlocked wall or line on the active level.

Parametric stair design

Two plan clicks define the stair orientation and scale. Custom points are normalized to the drawn length, not absolute project coordinates. Stair dimensions require professional code review.

Furniture / assembly schedule

Architectural hatches

Select a closed architectural boundary, then choose a hatch preset and spacing.

WALL ASSEMBLIES

Assembly-based hatch and poche display. Select a wall to customize its construction type.

Auto detail follows drawing sheet scale where available (Fine ≤1:25, Medium 1:26–1:75, Coarse ≥1:76). Hatch spacing is stored in model metres and projected into screen pixels; material layer buildup and plotted ISO/office standards require project-specific review.

Wall Junctions

Choose a wall in plan. End rules apply to its start and end nodes.

Select one wall, then choose a connection.

Supported: corner miters and thickness-aware butt / T junctions. Crossings without split nodes, staggered walls and multilayer material wraps require manual coordination.

VERTASCAN SKETCHBIM

Standalone architectural CAD/BIM evaluation build. Create and edit conceptual building objects, architectural/structural/MEP layers, technical assemblies, facades and project documentation.

Use the native SketchBIM tools on the left and property panels on the right. Undo/Redo: toolbar buttons. Use the drawing command line for coordinate entry. Backup before major geometry changes. Check room/door/stair dimensions and all structural or MEP proposals independently.

Evaluation scope: Geometric and BIM tools are conceptual. IFC exchange, structural loads, statutory approvals and all interactive commands have not been independently certified. This build is intended for professional evaluation, not construction-ready documents.

INTELLIGENT GROUPS & PROJECT DELIVERY

Vertascan SketchBIM · Model-linked typical assemblies and design-stage protocols

01 · Capture selection

Select walls, floors, hosted openings, furniture or other objects in plan, then create a reusable named assembly group.

Groups store object IDs. Hosted doors/windows are included when their parent wall is selected. Group definitions persist in SketchBIM project JSON; removing a definition does not delete the model objects.

02 · Repeat typical assemblies

Array the selected assembly horizontally, vertically or across building levels while maintaining source-object metadata and host mappings.

Each array copy receives new object IDs and original assembly properties. Existing source geometry is unchanged. Level arrays use SketchBIM level assignments and create new levels where enabled; 3D elevation comes from those level properties.

Ready.

Project delivery framework

Track scope, drawings, coordinated models, specifications and issue protocols from feasibility through construction documentation.

This is a workflow aid, not a regulatory approval or professional sign-off. Verify jurisdictional code, consultant deliverables, contract conditions and issuing authority requirements separately.
